title: 第1章 香不香第2章 杀我就凭你
slug: 九脉被夺我以魔种证无敌
lines: “秦逸，我的脚不香吗？你为何不舔？”
“我让你在死之前，品尝一下女人的滋味，你是不是得谢我？”
“若有来生，可要记得，将我当成女菩萨，好好地供起来！”
挂着粉色纱幔的密室内，长着狐媚脸，身形饱满，气质妖娆的女子，坐在床沿。
戴着脚链的一双玉足，踩着叫做秦逸的少年。
秦逸的身体，极为瘦弱，苍白的脸上，透着一抹倔意，双眼之中，涌动着怨恨的光芒。
他受了禁锢，无法动弹。
只有头部能活动，但他坚决不舔，一直牙关紧咬。
女子打量着脚下的秦逸，冷笑着说道：“你可知，我为什么忽然就盯上了你？”
“皆因昨夜，你那族兄，也就是我未来的夫君，他喝得酩酊大醉，然后透露了一个惊天大秘。”
“荒古大陆，秦家九子，人人如龙，声名远扬，可谁能想到，那九大妖孽的根，竟然都在你的身上！”
“虽然你那种不可思议的体质，本源已耗尽，可我觉得，怎么着也还得有一些残留吧？”
“正好我有一卷秘术，可以用在你的身上，若能从你这得到点什么，即便达不到秦家九子的高度，但也能让我再上一个台阶！”
“今日，我未来的家翁，带着他的宝贝女儿外出，我那昨夜纵酒的未婚夫还未醒来，如此良机，我可不能错过了！”
听到这最后一句话，被女子玉足踩着的秦逸，眼中忽然涌出一抹光芒。
他乃是荒古大陆秦家曾经的少主。
在他六岁那年，他的父亲秦道，将一座小鼎，放入他的脑海，告诉他，这是他的娘亲所留之物，秦道让他守住秘密，不可泄露小鼎的消息。
而后，秦道失踪。
秦逸九岁时，觉醒了传说中的混沌九玄体！
混沌九玄体，一年一神异，最终将拥有九种强大体质！
谁曾想，秦家新任家主秦沧，立刻封锁消息，关押秦逸。
秦逸被关押九年，每年诞生的体质，都会被秦沧挖取，移植给他的儿女。
不过，从秦逸的第一份体质被挖之际，他就得到了脑海中的小鼎相助，使用无上魔功，在体质本源中，留下了魔种！
魔种一旦成熟，只要收回，便可吞噬被魔种寄体之人的一切。
而且，收回的体质，还将迎来升华，变得更加强大。
如今，九年过去。
他们夺取了秦逸的天眼，神骨，霸体本源，伴生圣兽，纯阳圣体，玲珑心，五行道脉，先天剑魂，灵泉丹田。
秦逸的肉身，现在之所以还能保持完整，是因为秦沧担心他身体残缺，影响后续体质诞生。
所以每次挖取了秦逸的体质后，都会动用大药，帮他重新生长出普通的眼睛，心脏，骨骼，经脉。
半个月前，荒古大陆极具盛名的天星武院，将要招收新人。
秦沧带着他的八女儿秦飞雪，前来天星城参加考核。
而除了秦飞雪外，秦沧第九子秦永也跟着来了。
content_en:
"Qin Yi, don't my feet smell good? Why don't you lick them?"
"I let you taste the taste of a woman before you die. Do you have to thank me?"
"If there is an afterlife, please remember to treat me as a female Bodhisattva and make offerings to me properly!"
In a secret room hung with pink gauze curtains, a woman with a charming face, plump figure and enchanting temperament was sitting on the edge of the bed.
A pair of jade feet wearing anklets stepped on a young man named Qin Yi.
Qin Yi's body was extremely thin, his pale face showed a hint of stubbornness, and his eyes were filled with resentment.
He was restrained and unable to move.
Only the head could move, but he refused to lick and kept clenching his teeth.
The woman looked at Qin Yi at her feet and said with a sneer: "Do you know why I suddenly focused on you?"
"It's all because last night, your clan brother, my future husband, got extremely drunk and then revealed a shocking secret."
"In the Ancient Continent, the nine sons of the Qin family are all like dragons and their reputations are far and wide. But who would have thought that the roots of those nine monsters are all in your body!"
"Although the source of your incredible physique has been exhausted, I think there must still be some residue, right?"
"It just so happens that I have a secret technique that can be used on you. If I can get something from you, even if I don't reach the level of the nine sons of the Qin family, it can help me reach a higher level!"
"Today, my future father-in-law is going out with his baby daughter. My fiancé, who was drunk last night, hasn't woken up yet. I can't miss such a good opportunity!"
Hearing this last sentence, Qin Yi, who was stepped on by the woman's feet, suddenly had a flash of light in his eyes.
He was the former young master of the Qin family in the ancient continent.
When he was six years old, his father Qin Dao put a small cauldron in his mind and told him that it was a thing left by his mother. Qin Dao asked him to keep it a secret and not to reveal the information about the small cauldron.
Then, Qin Dao disappeared.
When Qin Yi was nine years old, he awakened the legendary Nine Mystical Body of Chaos!
The Nine Mystical Physics of Chaos, one magical thing every year, will eventually have nine powerful physiques!
Who would have thought that Qin Cang, the new head of the Qin family, would immediately block the news and imprison Qin Yi.
Qin Yi was imprisoned for nine years, and every year his body was harvested by Qin Cang and transplanted to his children.
However, from the moment Qin Yi's first physique was dug out, he got the help of Xiaoding in his mind, used supreme magic power, and left a demon seed in the origin of his physique!
Once the demon seed matures, as long as it is withdrawn, it can devour everything of the person possessed by the demon seed.
Moreover, the recovered physique will also undergo sublimation and become more powerful.
Now, nine years have passed.
They captured Qin Yi's Heavenly Eye, Divine Bone, Overlord Body Origin, Accompanying Sacred Beast, Pure Yang Sacred Body, Exquisite Heart, Five Elements Dao Meridian, Innate Sword Soul, and Lingquan Dantian.
The reason why Qin Yi's physical body is still intact is because Qin Cang is worried that his incomplete body will affect the birth of his subsequent physique.
Therefore, every time after Qin Yi's physique was harvested, powerful medicine would be used to help him grow ordinary eyes, heart, bones, and meridians again.
Half a month ago, the famous Tianxing Martial Academy in the Ancient Continent was about to recruit new people.
Qin Cang brought his eighth daughter Qin Feixue to Tianxing City to participate in the assessment.
In addition to Qin Feixue, Qin Cang's ninth son Qin Yong also came with him.
